crossRefs.note: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel…
Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” He blessed him there.

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”
translations.bsb: “Why do you ask my name,” said the angel of the LORD, “since it is beyond comprehension?”
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah said unto him, Wherefore askest thou after my name, seeing it is wonderful?
